The Center for Wooden Boats partners with Chesapeake Light Craft (CLC) to offer week-long "build your own boat" classes. Students build a CLC kit boat at CWB and take it home for final finishing (painting, varnishing). Watch the [building process](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9RyWUzHy3kA).

- **Tuition:** Members $995 / Non-members $1,125 / Helper $500
- **Materials:** Cost varies by boat; a 10% shipping fee is added to the kit cost. Kits must be purchased in full from CWB no later than 45 days before class — register online, then call 206-382-2628 to purchase your kit.
- CWB provides all tools and materials; students may bring their own tools.
- **Ages:** 18+ · **Time:** 9am - 5pm · **Class size:** 6 boats · **Location:** South Lake Union
- **Instructor:** Casey Wilkinson with Kea Kayaks

### FAQ can be found [here](https://www.clcboats.com/default/boatbuildingclassfaqs.html)

## Intro To Epoxy (Sponsored By CLC): TBD

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/33c4ac99-8e7a-4ed6-8f90-551a8f1eebbc/epoxy+pic+2.jpg)

A 3-hour class, no prerequisite. Covers epoxy safety, fillet techniques, fiberglass tape over fillets, fiberglassing over wood, fill-coating, rail lamination, and installing a breasthook. Useful for anyone planning to build a CLC kit.

## Introduction to Stitch and Glue Boatbuilding: TBD

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/4892f583-0876-4751-9d95-c11a2029ee2a/IMG_3048.jpg)

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/496cc12d-1425-485e-9512-be197d18f259/IMG_3036.jpg)

Help build a couple of CLC kits alongside CWB instructors. Learn to read plans, use epoxy, stitch kits together, sand and fillet, and lay fiberglass.

- $500 CWB members / $575 non-members

## STITCH & GLUE KAYAK (Shearwater or Wood Duck):
## MAY 4 - 9, 2026

*Registration closed for this class.*

![Wood Duck 12’](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/1579116002854-0B3P5KNGJD491G57GQ5S/Wood-Duck12-Kayak---profiles.png)

Assemble the pre-cut plywood hull and deck with copper wire and epoxy, cut hatches, fiberglass the boat, and install the cockpit coaming. Outfitting (seats, foot braces, hatch fittings, deck rigging) is also covered. For kit details [click here](https://clcboats.com/shop/kayak-kits/recreational-kayaks/).

### Instructor: Casey Wilkinson

![](https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5c48db894eddeca43abfade1/4eaf5365-6915-4c2f-b2a5-1f6ad53784eb/casey+w.jpg)

Casey has a life-long passion for the ocean and boatbuilding. He built his first boat, a Chesapeake Triple kayak, in 2006 and started Kea Kayaks soon after, renaming it Kea Custom Boats in 2019 to reflect the wider range of boats he builds. He began teaching CLC classes at CWB in 2018, has built over 50 boats, and works from his home workshop on Bainbridge Island.

## Cancellation Policy

- Cancel/change more than 90 days before start: full refund less a $100 admin fee.
- 90–60 days before start: $100 admin fee and tuition credit (no cash refund) toward a course in the same calendar year. Kit purchases refunded less $100 if CLC has not shipped the kit; if shipped, participant takes ownership.
- 60–30 days before start: 50% tuition credit (no cash refund) toward a course in the same calendar year; same kit rules.
- 30 days or less: no refund or credit; participant takes ownership of any purchased kit.
- CWB may cancel a course for emergencies or low enrollment and will refund participants in full.
- CWB recommends refundable airline tickets or flight insurance and is not responsible for non-refundable travel losses.
